body: You're retiring: Casa's work is moving to a new cloud environment and named, persistent sessions, and this session is being archived. Before it is, put everything that lives only here into the repo. 1) git fetch origin claude/main. If anything you built isn't pushed, push it to your branch now and say which branch. Don't start new work. 2) Write docs/parked/sessions/agent-cms.md, short and plain: what you built and where it lives (files, branches, PRs); what's unfinished or broken, and how you'd fix it; decisions, findings and ideas that exist only in this conversation; and anything waiting on Kimani. Your track continues as Concierge (agent sites and the CMS): end the file with the restart kickoff for Concierge, from "Restarting a track in a new session" in docs/dispatch/README.md, naming what's next (Slice 5, Slices 2–3 once the Wix capture exists, and agent-record fields such as Instagram handles). 3) Open a docs-only PR to claude/main. Never merge. Sign "— the Dispatch 03 session (retiring)". When the PR opens, mark Dispatch Ledger line casa-r8-1 delivered (rule 11 in docs/dispatch/README.md). Then tell Kimani in chat that you're done.
summary: Put what lives only in this session into the repo, then archive.
